verdict.rationale: Ramp Travel shows live policy status per booking option ('See policy status for every option... no wondering if trips will get rejected'), per diem auto-adjusted by trip, and automatic hotel rebooking on price drops, meaning policy is enforced at time of booking rather than post-hoc expensing. This is reinforced by broader Ramp policy-at-point-of-spend design (auto-approval within policy, no expense report filed) and CLI/MCP travel resources. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reviews confirming the in-platform booking flow and policy UI work smoothly in practice, and more detail on the actual booking UI/flight search beyond marketing copy.
